name: Temporal Entity and Relation Graph
mechanism: Stores entities and relations with event time, ingestion time, validity intervals and source episodes for relational and temporally constrained retrieval.
use_when: Questions traverse relationships across people objects and events
Facts change over time and current versus historical truth matters
avoid_when: The corpus is small and flat retrieval already meets recall
Entity resolution errors cannot be reviewed or corrected
expected_effects: Visible supersession instead of destructive overwrite
failure_modes: Stale edges remain active after supersession
